name: print-social-creative-agency-poster-bauhaus-shapes-icon-services
title: 'Creative Agency' poster with a Bauhaus shape header band and three circular service icons
whatItIs: A cream A4 poster with a coral-and-navy Bauhaus shape band (circles, a starburst, a squiggle, a jagged triangle) across the top, a bold two-tone 'CREATIVE AGENCY' title, a highlighted tagline bar, three circular navy icon badges (rocket, lightbulb, connection) labelled Production, Big Ideas and Connections, and a puzzle-piece logo.
whatItMeans: Playful and structured; a Bauhaus shape band signals creativity before a single word is read.
techniques: Open a poster with a horizontal band of abstract shapes.
Circle each service icon in a matching dark badge.
Highlight the tagline in a solid colour bar.

vocabulary.definition: A horizontal strip of decorative geometric forms.
A circular container holding a service icon.
